prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder) is helpful, averaging +3.0% after noise correction across 3 tests with 2 wins, though 1 test showed no clear effect.
Finish redesigns (finish, redesign) are helpful, averaging +2.5% after noise correction across 2 tests with 1 win, though 1 test showed no clear effect.
Evidence is still thin for new adoption screens and flows (adoption, new_screen and adoption, new_flow) with only 1 test each, both showing no clear effect.
Evidence is still thin for path choice redesigns (choose_path, redesign) with only 1 test, which showed no clear effect.
Predictions are often too high, overestimating actual noise-corrected impact in most tests.
Predictions can sometimes underestimate actual impact, as in round 6 (+1.5% predicted vs +3.1% noise-corrected) and round 7 (+2.2% predicted vs +4.6% noise-corrected).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +0.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, new_screen: +0.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: +1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: +2.5% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.0% after noise correction, 3 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 81.5%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 71.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Existing account pet sync warning: Display a explicit notice on the sign-in screen advising users to sign in with their original account to preserve existing pets. (why: 8 support tickets reported missing or reset pets after signing in again, pointing to accidental duplicate account creation.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Interactive pet personality selector redesign: Redesign the friend picker screen with a split layout and interactive choice cards to select pet personality and play style. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate (60.9%) in the entire funnel, showing a need for a more engaging selection experience.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop pet roaming mode selector screen: Insert a new screen before home intro allowing users to choose whether their pet roams screen-wide or stays anchored to the taskbar. (why: Support emails show post-onboarding confusion regarding controlling and positioning desktop pets after setup.)
3: [choose_path, layout] Split screen path comparison layout: Switch the path selection layout to a split layout comparing standard premade pets directly alongside custom pet creation. (why: Choose path has a 76.2% conversion rate and high mean completion time (514s), indicating user hesitation.)
4: [home, wait_info] Pet generation progress and status tips: Show an active progress status indicator and detailed generation phase tips while waiting for pet creation. (why: The waiting step has a long mean completion time of 2336s, leading to drop-off if users feel stuck.)
5: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder sign in after pet waiting step: Move the sign-in step to occur right after pet generation completes, directly before the home intro screen. (why: Past test lessons confirm sign-in reordering consistently improves overall funnel completion (+3.0% average).)
6: [adoption, new_flow] Pet photo customization studio flow: Introduce a dedicated photo refinement step between photo upload and adoption certificate to adjust lighting and pet color palette. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected pet appearance.)
7: [choose_path, copy] Instant path switch reassurance copy: Update the choose path headline and subtext to reassure users they can change pet paths anytime without losing progress. (why: High mean path choice time (514s) signals anxiety over picking the wrong option.)
8: [home, notification] Desktop launch notification alert on ready: Enable desktop notification options on the waiting screen to alert users when pet generation is finished if the app is minimized. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not appearing or app not opening, combined with long average waiting times (2336s).)
